item.title: Indiana Data Protection Law Goes Into Effect January 1
item.description: Indiana’s new consumer data privacy law begins enforcement Thursday, Jan. 1, giving residents expanded control over their personal information and placing new requirements on businesses that collect and process large amounts of data.

item.title: Milford PD To Increase Holiday Patrols, Promote Safe Roads
item.description: As Hoosiers prepare for holiday celebrations, the Milford Police Department is partnering with the Indiana Criminal Justice Institute to keep roads safe and prevent traffic fatalities as part of the annual Safe Family Travel campaign, supported by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.

item.title: Indiana Cigarette Tax Hike: Consumption Down, Quit Program Enrollment Up
item.description: Cigarette consumption in Indiana dropped 40% during the first three months of a long-sought tax increase, according to the Indiana Department of Health. Enrollment in the agency’s smoking cessation program jumped almost 40% over that time.
